Every day for 30 days

Each evening at 8:00 PM the Daily Check-in opens. It stays open until 8:00 PM the next day. Tap Show Surveys on the home page to answer it.


It asks whether you took or used your hormonal contraception today, per your regular schedule, which symptoms you are having today, and how severe each of those symptoms is.


Answer the contraception question the same way whether your method is taken every day, every week, or on another schedule.
